description: TU Delft and University of Genoa researchers publish KCS container-ship hull variations generated with Free-Form Deformation. CFD simulations and stability assessments compare resistance and compliance with the IMO Second Generation Intact Stability criteria. The resource describes geometries, geometric parameters, operating conditions and resistance data for physically constrained design studies. Coverage: Temporal coverage is not stated in the reviewed source. Geographic extent follows the named site or scope; unstated extents and sampling intervals remain unknown. Access: public 4TU.ResearchData metadata links describe the release. Formats: tool-specific files, source scripts. Licence: CC-BY-NC-4.0. Cost and present file access are unverified. Caveats: Metadata describing regulatory criteria does not establish design approval or compliance of a real ship. Simulation uses follow the source-defined purpose above. Related resources are retained in the same native collection with their distinct identities.
